problem: The conditional support logic rejects a fixed support when the member terminates within an ice-strengthened area but has no continuous-through-support, connection-bracket, or demonstrated-restraint flag. The requirement independently permits and requires fixity for members terminating within an ice-strengthened area.
required_change: Exclude the ice-termination case from the invalid fixed-condition branch, or otherwise make fixedFrameSupport valid when terminatesWithinIceStrengthenedArea is true.
regression_guard: Preserve the rule that ice-area termination requires fixedFrameSupport, while allowing that condition to establish fixity even without the other qualifying indicators.
